sn47.95-104:4.4: vitthāretuvaggo → This mention as well as the Uddāna is to be found in S1-3 only, but put before the last text of the vaggo (uddambhāgiyāni). (pts note) | vitthāretabbaṁ → This summing up mention is in B1-2 only instead of the mention of the chapters V11-X. (pts note) | samattaṁ → This word added in S1-3 only. To be noticed. The sixth text of this Saṁyutta (the sakuṇagghī pages 146-147) occurs frequently. See particularly Milinda (pāli) p. 365;-- Julien's avadānas N.99--Lane's arabian nights.2.58. (pts note) | Sāvatthi → B2 adds yam. (pts note)
